_baseline_context.ai_ml_risk_language: Every in-window 10-K carries generic AI/ML risk-factor language. 'artificial intelligence' appears in all 8 10-Ks (FY2018 filed 2019-02-01 through FY2025 filed 2026-02-06); 'machine learning' in the 7 10-Ks from FY2019 (2020-01-31) onward. Framing is generic: (a) government regulation of 'artificial intelligence technologies and services' may be unfavorable; (b) 'our and our customers' development and use of artificial intelligence may result in increased claims of infringement or other claims'; (c) 'practical applications of artificial intelligence and machine learning' increase competition. No incident-specific naming.
_baseline_context.adjacent_risk_families: Long-standing product-liability risk factor ('products we sell or manufacture expose us to product liability ... relating to personal injury or illness, death'); fraudulent/unlawful/objectionable seller-goods-and-content risk factor; data/privacy/security risk factors; labor/employment risk. Worker-safety appears in the Business/Human-Capital section ('new safety technology, vehicle safety controls'), not as a standalone risk factor.
_baseline_context.autonomous_zoox: 'autonomous' first appears in FY2022 10-K (2023-02-03) and 10-Qs from Q1 2023; described in MD&A as investment in 'autonomous vehicles for ride-hailing services' (Zoox), NOT as an AV-safety/accident risk factor. 'Zoox' appears ONLY in 8-K earnings press-release exhibits (99.1), DEF 14A, and ARS as positive business highlights - never in 10-K/10-Q risk factors or legal proceedings, and never in connection with a crash or recall.
_baseline_context.legal_proceedings: Note 7 (Commitments & Contingencies - Legal Proceedings), confirmed via Q1 2026 10-Q (0001018724-26-000014): only named product-family matter is Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute v. Amazon (Alexa Voice Software PATENT suit, unrelated to any incident here). Otherwise only generic categories (patent/IP, tax, labor/employment, antitrust, privacy, consumer protection, government inquiries). No named matter for Zoox/NHTSA/autonomous vehicles, warehouse worker safety, delivery-driver monitoring, Alexa content, or recommendation algorithms. => No incident qualifies for T2.
_baseline_context.negative_fts: efts CIK-restricted full-text searches returning NO HITS: 'time off task', 'delivery service partners', 'generative artificial intelligence' (exact phrase). Confirms no incident-specific naming (no T1).
